notes: Machine-readable companion to docs/PROTOCOL_V2.md. Programs/tools/generate_hornet_catalog.py turns this file into libraries/HornetLink/src/protocol/HnSpec.h and docs/PROTOCOL_V2_MESSAGES.md. Edit this file, not the generated outputs. Enum prefixes avoid names that Arduino cores define as macros (INPUT, CONFIG_*).

addresses.name: BROADCAST
addresses.description: Every node processes the frame. Never used as a source.

addresses.name: LINK_NODE
addresses.description: The board attached to the PC over USB: a bus master or a standalone panel.

addresses.name: UNASSIGNED
addresses.description: A slave that has no bus address yet. Only used as a source in HELLO during discovery.

messages.name: HELLO_REQUEST
messages.description: Ask a node to identify itself. The node answers with HELLO.

messages.name: HELLO
messages.description: Identity and capabilities. role is a bit set of ROLE_*.

messages.name: DESCRIBE_REQUEST
messages.description: Ask for one page of the node's control list.

messages.name: DESCRIBE
messages.description: Controls the node owns. role 0 = input (node -> sim), 1 = output (sim -> node).

messages.name: SUBSCRIBE
messages.description: Replace the node's output subscription. scope is one of SUBSCRIBE_*.

messages.name: STATE
messages.description: Sim state keyed by catalogue id. kind is one of VALUE_*: BOOL/POSITION value is u8, ANALOG is u16, TEXT is [len:u8][bytes].

messages.name: INPUT
messages.description: Cockpit input events. action is one of ACTION_*. The frame sequence number is used for duplicate detection and ACK.

messages.name: SYNC_REQUEST
messages.description: Ask the node to report the physical position of every input it owns.

messages.name: SYNC_REPORT
messages.description: Physical positions (position index, or 0-65535 for axes). flags bit 0 = last page of the report.

messages.name: MODE
messages.description: Change operating mode. mode is one of MODE_*.

messages.name: MODE_ACK
messages.description: The mode the node applied.

messages.name: ACK
messages.description: The frame with sequence acked_seq was accepted.

messages.name: NACK
messages.description: The frame was rejected. reason is one of NACK_*.

messages.name: DIAG_REQUEST
messages.description: Ask for diagnostic counters.

messages.name: DIAG
messages.description: Counters since boot plus an optional short text message.

messages.name: CONFIG
messages.description: Change a setting. key is one of CFG_*. The node answers ACK or NACK.

messages.name: HEARTBEAT
messages.description: Keeps an idle USB link alive.

messages.name: POLL
messages.description: The addressed slave may transmit exactly one frame now.

messages.name: POLL_EMPTY
messages.description: Reply to POLL when the slave has nothing to send.

messages.name: DISCOVER
messages.description: Slaves that have not been polled recently answer HELLO in one random slot.

messages.name: BUS_EVENT
messages.description: A slave joined, dropped off or has an address conflict. event is one of BUS_*.

NACK.name: UNKNOWN_CONTROL
NACK.description: The control id is not in the catalogue.

NACK.name: BAD_VALUE
NACK.description: The value or action does not fit the control type.

NACK.name: WRONG_MODE
NACK.description: Inputs are ignored in the current mode.

NACK.name: CATALOG_MISMATCH
NACK.description: The node was built against a different catalogue hash.

NACK.name: UNSUPPORTED
NACK.description: The message or config key is not supported.

MODE.name: SIM
MODE.description: Live DCS data; inputs forwarded to DCS.

MODE.name: LAMP_TEST
MODE.description: All outputs on; inputs not forwarded.

MODE.name: WIRING_TEST
MODE.description: Each input reports its name when actuated; inputs not forwarded.

SUBSCRIBE.name: PANELS
SUBSCRIBE.description: Every output in the listed panel ids (high byte of a control id).

BUS.name: JOIN
BUS.description: The slave answered for the first time, or again after being dropped. The bridge should resend full state.

BUS.name: DROP
BUS.description: The slave missed too many polls and is now polled slowly.

BUS.name: CONFLICT
BUS.description: Two boards answered with the same bus address.

ACTION.name: STEP
ACTION.description: Relative step; arg is a signed 16-bit count.

CFG.name: BUS_ADDRESS
CFG.description: [address:u8] Change the slave bus address (RAM only until SAVE).

CFG.name: SAVE
CFG.description: Persist settings through the sketch's save hook.
